title: The 3 Best Smart Speakers 2026
metaDescription: Our 3 picks for smart speakers 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.

products.name: Amazon Echo Dot (5th Gen)
products.blurb: Key specs: Compact spherical design, Improved audio over 4th Gen, Temperature sensor built in.
strengths: Temperature sensor useful for automation triggers
Audio improved significantly from previous generation
limitations: Audio quality is for ambient listening, not music-focused listening
No built-in smart home hub (Zigbee requires full Echo)
